==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am being followed by a wandering ghost. The ghost has short orange hair, a mustache, and green eyes. He wears a red shirt and white pants.  Everyone can see him, but only my friends and I can tell that he's a ghost. He can fly and phase through walls.  He is frustrated that he is tethered to me. He used to wander the world. He distinctly hates rich people, due to family trauma from his past.
